shared_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE elegant redesigned desktop project-detail webpage screenshot for APSI BTP, a French construction coordination firm. Landscape composition for viewport 1400×720. Input 1 is CURRENT project detail page with actual values and visible demonstration placeholders; input 2 shows its continuation/related-project section; input 3 is the approved company page and establishes the exact visual identity. Keep APSI white logo on blue trapezoid left header, original navigation labels and Nous contacter button right, navy #061733, blue #0067d6, white and extremely pale-blue surfaces, Montserrat bold headings and Inter text, restrained rounded corners/shadows, blue outline icons, generous but useful space. Improve hierarchy, photo proportions, alignment and information readability. Respect 94px left and right content margins in this 1400px composition, consistent with header. No extra brand colors. Do NOT add crane image to the project detail: showcase the actual photographed historic building from input1. Browser-free flat screenshot, no mockup device, no outside labels or framing. All typography readable at intended 1400x720. No cropped key information or awkward text overflow. Related-project section may continue naturally below the fold; do not compress whole long page into miniature text.
Exact project content: L’hôtel des Monnaies-Niel; AVIGNON (84); Restructuration et réhabilitation. Maître d’ouvrage: Groupe E-Hôtel (69). Architecte: Architecte Test. Équipe de maîtrise d’œuvre: Équipe Test. Nombre de phases: XXX. Nombre d’entreprises: 18. Nombre de lots: 25. Période: 2024–2027. Durée: 20 mois. Statut: Travaux en cours. Montant des travaux: 8 000 000 € HT. Gallery has 9 photos with 01 / 09 indicator and previous/next controls. Back link: Retour à nos références. If a short description is used, use only: Reconversion de l’hôtel des Monnaies-Niel pour la création d’un hôtel de 40 chambres, Place du Palais des Papes à Avignon. Do not invent facts, awards or dates. Keep the words Test and XXX literally visible as placeholders, not fake real names. Preserve every listed datum in the design, with clear labels. The design must be coherent with approved site pages while providing a much better project reading experience.
